scope: Audit amended V2 freeze §§6.2–6.4, 7, 8, 17 and relevant SESSION041 requirement matrix clauses. No source edits, network calls, authentication, capital/assisted authority, or final holdout access.
frozen_constraints: Keep V1 BTC/ETH frozen benchmark unchanged.
V2 public observation covers dynamically observed active USDT linear perpetuals across both Bybit and Binance; eligibility is explicit and point-in-time.
Bybit and Binance public observation may operate simultaneously.
Capital and assisted authority remain false; no automatic capital eligibility.
Do not claim external/live feed availability or completeness based on offline fixtures.

findings.gap: Production public acquisition is a fixed Bybit BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT campaign. Metadata bootstrap requests one Bybit instrument-info page (limit 1000), then filters to those two symbols; snapshot acquisition iterates the same two products. The stream topic factory, stream identity resolver, bootstrap validation, product refresh validation, and stream projection are also symbol-fixed and Bybit-specific.
findings.classification: Ordinary implementation gap: no dynamic all-active-product public acquisition or multi-venue production composition exists. Fixed BTC/ETH limits are part of existing S31/S32 campaign scope and must stay unchanged for the V1 benchmark.

findings.gap: Binance has typed credential-free REST transport, exchangeInfo translation, and endpoint readers, but no Binance cycle source, product metadata acquisition/persistence path, public source production factory, or Binance WebSocket acquisition integration was found. Its existing depth bridge is a typed snapshot/frame boundary, not a connected transport/source.
findings.classification: Ordinary implementation gap. AUTH02 §7.3 lists permitted Binance public targets; this audit does not infer actual feed qualification, semantics, or completeness from endpoint support.

findings.gap: A point-in-time dynamic universe builder exists, but it consumes caller-supplied observations and is not connected to venue discovery, public collection, or the production supervisor. It cannot itself establish that the observed contract population is complete or current.
findings.classification: Reusable model/runtime seam; acquisition-to-universe composition is missing.

findings.gap: Metadata freshness is represented by Bybit's one-hour in-memory cache; a refresh is attempted after expiry, but a broad contract inventory, paged metadata cursor, durable source revision lineage, explicit stale-age eligibility limit, and multi-venue metadata merge are not implemented. The collector does preserve product revisions and has a 4,096 active registry/product-evidence bound, but that is not dynamic universe population orchestration.
findings.classification: Ordinary implementation gap. Existing product revision and capacity mechanisms are reusable; do not silently evict retained evidence.

findings.gap: Compute tiers are deterministic for a supplied population: scanner ordering is descending turnover with canonical instrument identity tie-break; top_tier_2 defaults to 20 and top_tier_3 to 5, with open positions/watches included in tier 3. These are engineering defaults only. The V2 tier/universe seam does not implement or persist deterministic known-probability exploration outside its shortlist; a separate legacy scanner exploration facility exists and is not wired into this V2 universe/subscription path. The builder has no input/population cap; the subscription planner materializes every provided key.
findings.classification: Partial implementation plus ordinary gaps against AUTH02 §§8.2–8.3. Existing 4,096 product registry ceiling does not bound all caller inputs, universe rows, or subscription-plan rows.

findings.gap: Eligibility currently uses trading status, required-bars boolean, health, observed days, turnover, spread, and caller-supplied policy history days. It records data/scanner eligibility and policy-level history eligibility, and hard-sets deep-analysis/capital eligibility false. It does not derive observed-days/history from persisted causal records, evaluate freshness by feed age, or produce explicit eligibility reasons per strategy beyond a generic history/data reason. S6's minimum of 20 strategy-eligible instruments/NOT_ESTIMABLE is not enforced in this builder.
findings.classification: Partial eligibility contract implementation; history measurement and S6 cross-sectional population gate are missing at this seam.

reusable_seams.use: Preserve venue, environment, product, native symbol, asset identity, contract revision, timestamps, filters, and metadata ref as canonical inputs.

reusable_seams.interface: PublicCollectorV2 / raw store / source health / archive-first observation indexing
reusable_seams.use: Reuse for bounded credential-free source acquisition, raw payload hash, receipt chronology, health, durable indexing, and revision evidence. Current source adapters return immutable bounded snapshots before the supervisor-owned writer persists them.
Build causal UniverseContractV2 and deterministic tiers from already acquired/validated point-in-time observations; keep capital_eligible false.

reusable_seams.interface: SubscriptionPlanV2 / restore_subscription_plan and existing legacy scanner exploration
reusable_seams.use: Translate tier maps, restored watches, and open positions to deterministic channel plans; add explicit population/topic bounds before dynamic broad use. The legacy scanner has deterministic known-probability selection, but it is a separate seam and must not be assumed to satisfy V2 point-in-time universe exploration/persistence.

Supervisor-owned persistence/revision registration and opt-in source lifecycle exist, but current validation and routing assumptions require a venue-aware generalization with strict per-venue identifiers.

minimal_interface_recommendation.shape: Introduce a venue-neutral bounded public metadata/acquisition source contract that yields immutable per-venue snapshots: venue/source identity, metadata receipt/availability, page/cursor completeness, ProductContractV2 revisions, bounded market observations, explicit failure/stale state, and request/record budgets. Compose separate Bybit and Binance source instances concurrently through the existing supervisor-owned persistence path; merge only validated point-in-time products keyed by the full InstrumentKeyV2. Feed the persisted causal observations into DynamicUniverseRuntimeV2 and then a bounded SubscriptionPlanV2. Keep the current fixed BTC/ETH campaign factories and fixture contracts intact.
requirements: Page/continue or explicitly fail incomplete metadata enumeration; do not treat one page as the full venue inventory.
Attach source, venue, revision, receipt, availability, completeness, and staleness evidence; reject unavailable/future or stale metadata at a decision cutoff.
Bound each venue's page requests, records, active contracts, tier population, topic fanout, and retained active caches; publish explicit pressure/failure instead of truncation.
Make tier ordering and exploration deterministic; persist the exact selection policy, tier inputs, and known inclusion probability for any sampled exploration.
Compute strategy eligibility from causal history and explicit required inputs; enforce S6 minimum cross-sectional breadth as NOT_ESTIMABLE below 20 eligible instruments.
Allow Bybit and Binance observations simultaneously while retaining source-specific health and never joining solely by symbol text.
Keep data/scanner/deep-analysis eligibility distinct from capital eligibility; capital remains false.

focused_acceptance_tests: Fake paged Bybit and Binance metadata sources enumerate all declared active USDT linear perpetuals, bind each revision to actual receipt/availability, and fail closed for missing/duplicate pages, cursor loops, stale metadata, malformed rows, or request-budget exhaustion.
Mixed-venue fixture with same native symbol yields distinct full instrument keys and independently tracked source health; both venue sources can contribute in one decision slot.

Cutoff tests exclude future metadata and stale/unhealthy source observations; status, listing, delisting, tick/lot, multiplier, or revision changes only affect snapshots after their causal availability.

Universe fixture verifies scanner defaults (30 observed days, required bars, $10m turnover, 10 bps spread), policy-specific history, all eligibility fields/reasons, and capital false; verify fewer than 20 S6-eligible instruments yields NOT_ESTIMABLE.
Tier repeatability test permutes identical observation input and confirms same tiers/plans, turnover tie-break by canonical full key, top-20/top-5 defaults, and watch/open-position inclusion.
Exploration test confirms deterministic sample and exact known inclusion probabilities are persisted, is reproducible from the policy hash/seed, and cannot set capital eligibility.
Population/topic/cache boundary tests exercise exactly-at-limit and limit+1 behavior; overflow yields durable/visible fail-closed evidence, not a partial universe or silent subscription truncation.

Production composition fixture runs both fake venue sources through supervisor-owned persistence, creates one merged point-in-time universe and bounded channel plan, and confirms no network/auth/capital/assisted path is invoked.
non_claims: No live venue calls or external qualification were performed.
No claim that public data is complete, fresh, or semantically qualified for either venue.
No claim that Binance WS/depth/liquidation acquisition is currently connected; existing typed bridges/readers alone do not establish this.
No changes to frozen V1, capital authority, assisted authority, thresholds, or frozen contracts are authorized by this audit.
